offering_description.value: Century Casinos operates casinos and racetracks for gaming customers and horse-racing bettors. Its properties also serve leisure travelers and event groups through hotels, restaurants and entertainment venues.

primary_services.value: casino gaming; hotel accommodation; food and beverage service; horse racing and off-track wagering; entertainment and event hosting

customer_segment.value: B2C: Casino patrons, horse-racing bettors, hotel guests, diners and entertainment visitors; B2B: Sportsbook operators and corporate event organizers

end_markets.value: casino gaming; hospitality and tourism; horse racing and wagering; live entertainment and events

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: Net proceeds from slot machines and table games, plus a share of pari-mutuel wagers; service fees: Hotel stays, food and beverages, entertainment admissions and event services; project or contract: Market-access agreements with third-party sportsbook operators
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees; project or contract

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: Uses owned and leased facilities to offer gaming, racing and hospitality to visitors; service provider: Uses hospitality staff and event facilities to serve hotel guests, diners and event groups

geography_served.value: North America: United States and Alberta, Canada

specialization.value: related lines: Casinos, racetracks, wagering, hotels, dining and entertainment

distribution_channels.value: own locations: Company-operated casinos, racetracks, hotels and restaurants; online: Property websites for hotel reservations; partners / resellers: Third-party sportsbook operators and off-track betting outlets

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Casino gaming and pari-mutuel wagering require licenses from state and provincial gaming and racing authorities

notes: The geography reflects confirmed North American operations, and current ownership of the Polish casino business is uncertain.
